lines.explanation: The referent set for O1 is the four lunch-question messages (1699572000.000789, 1706052027.000000, 1706052160.000000, 1706052665.000000), excluding the pizza-combo message. The agent added :thumbsup: to only two of these four (1699572000.000789 and 1706052665.000000), missing 1706052027.000000 (pizza quantity question) and 1706052160.000000 (garlic knots question). It also added :thumbsup: to 1706051755.000000, the pizza-combo message that O1 explicitly excludes, treating it as a lunch question despite the card's instruction to exclude it. This is both a partial performance (two of four correct targets covered) and an incorrect reference handling (the excluded message was wrongly included), so the collection requirement for 'all' lunch-question messages except the pizza-combo one was violated.

The agent correctly identified the pizza-combo message (1706051755.000000, Mateo's message referencing the French press + pizza combo and ordering quantity) and added :thumbsdown: to it, matching the resolved referent set for O2.
